17. As against the aforesaid long series of decisions Mr. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed has, first of all, cited a decision of the Calcutta High Court in Province of Bengal Vs. Amulya Dhan reported in 54 CWN page 297. In this case, an appeal was preferred against the decision of a Tribunal constituted under the Calcutta Improvement Act (V of 1911) before the Calcutta High Court beyond the period of limitation and the question arose whether the delay could be condoned by applying section 5 of the Limitation Act. 

 22. In the next place, Mr. Ahmed has cited a decision of this Court in the case of Rokeya Begum Vs. Radha Gobinda reported in 27 DLR page 418.
